name: cr514_3a_cleanup_trigger_gets_priority
why: CR 514.3a: a trigger during cleanup (Emrakul's discard shuffle) goes on the stack and players get priority, so it can be Stifled - 84145d4
expect_order: Player B discards Emrakul, the Aeons Torn
Player A casts Stifle targeting Emrakul, the Aeons Torn's ability
Emrakul, the Aeons Torn's ability is countered
